changelog: Modify numeral bias: keep general upward bias for numerals/dates/names but add explicit exception to lower scores when a NUM on the left is immediately followed by a measurement unit or counted noun (targets band 10–35). Rationale: addresses measured over-trust where numeral↔unit splits are risky (trace: critique cases en_us_66 etc.).

Add rule to lower scores when a numeral/ordinal on one side is immediately adjacent to a coordinator in a coordination or range (and/or/to), treating such cuts as risky (target band 10–35). Rationale: addresses measured over-trust for numeral↔(and|or|to) splits.

Introduce a deterministic same-bucket tie-break procedure inside Scoring Rules: apply a small position-based offset and a token-class priority (units < ordinals < plain NUM) before rounding to integers so markers never tie. Rationale: implements the critique's tie_fix to avoid identical integers while keeping decision deterministic.

Update Examples to reflect the new numeral/unit and numeral↔coordinator lowering tendencies (changed the outputs for the 1,200 tests example and the climate 'one to two degree' example) so examples remain testable and consistent with rules.
